name: Milwaukee County, WI
findings: Milwaukee County has 3,806 nonprofit organizations. 1,527 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,240 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Milwaukee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 32 political organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 15 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do political organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 333 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
